description: This year, the Legislature adjourned its regular session two days early, even though we hadn’t passed a budget yet. And a special session did not begin until four days later. I suspect the break was designed to take advantage of a loophole that allows legislators to raise campaign funds immediately before a special session. That’s … Continued
